roster_context.source: Mongo repository seed/current state as of 2026-09-11 Demercado add + Malik Davis IR confirmation

watchlist_status.note: ffdb waiver-watch has no seeded Mongo entries. Pulse treats unowned names as discovery only with availability UNKNOWN.

player_signals.summary: ESPN Cowboys reporter Todd Archer, citing a source, reports Davis is scheduled to have hip surgery Saturday and will be placed on injured reserve after being carted off Friday practice and ruled out for Week 1 vs NYG. Stephen Jones already called the hip injury pretty serious.
player_signals.mongo_impact: Davis is already OWNED and on the Mongo IR slot. NFL IR would lock him out at least four games and may end his 2026 stash value. Do not start. Do not drop solely to chase noise; IR seat is already used.
sources: Stephen Jones on 105.3 The Fan via official/team reporting

player_signals.summary: With Davis out and expected to miss extended time, Demercado is the current Cowboys RB2 behind Javonte Williams. Hunter Luepke and practice-squad Israel Abanikanda are the other named options. Dallas may still add another back.
player_signals.mongo_impact: Demercado is OWNED on the Mongo bench after a confirmed $0 add once Davis moved to IR. Hold as the Javonte handcuff. Week 1 standalone value is limited if Williams is the bell cow.
sources: ESPN Archer feature on Davis being ruled out

player_signals.summary: In the Melbourne Week 1 win, Black out-carried Christian McCaffrey 14-10 for 65 yards plus 1-5 receiving. Snap split was roughly CMC 35-36 / Black 28. Jordan James was a healthy inactive, confirming Black as SF RB2. CMC kept third-down and most red-zone priority.
player_signals.mongo_impact: Black is already OWNED on the Mongo bench. Usage upgraded him from pure handcuff to RB2 with occasional standalone early-down work. Not a drop.

player_signals.summary: Saints final Week 1 report: Audric Estime (thigh) OUT, Alvin Kamara (knee) QUESTIONABLE after a full Friday practice. Beat reporter Nick Underhill says Kamara will not have a huge role if active because New Orleans is deep at RB; Travis Etienne should lead, with Miller next.
player_signals.mongo_impact: Miller is OWNED on the bench. He is the clearest change-of-pace/RB3 with a path to extra Week 1 work if Kamara is limited or inactive. Still not a start over Achane/Bijan.
sources: Saints official/final injury report via Saints Wire and NewOrleansSaints.com
Nick Underhill / New Orleans Football via NBC Rotoworld and X amplification

player_signals.summary: Raiders unofficial depth chart lists Tucker as a starting WR. Brock Bowers (knee/meniscus) is OUT Week 1 vs Miami. Some expert notes bump Tucker as a volume beneficiary; FantasyPros Primer remains cooler on using him as a Week 1 flex.
player_signals.mongo_impact: Tucker is OWNED on the Mongo bench. Bowers absence is a real target-share tailwind, but current Week 1 starters already include Burden, McMillan, Downs, and Lamb. Leave Tucker on the bench unless a starter is ruled out.
sources: CBS Sports Week 1 injury tracker (Bowers out)
FantasyPros Week 1 Primer / STACKED expert notes

player_signals.summary: Falcons start Cooper Rush in Week 1 at Pittsburgh with Michael Penix Jr. (knee) and Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) both out. ESPN Fantasy still instructs managers to keep Bijan, Drake London, and Kyle Pitts in lineups.
player_signals.mongo_impact: Bijan remains a locked Mongo RB starter. QB downgrade is a modest passing-game concern, not a sit.

player_signals.summary: FantasyPros Week 1 PPR consensus (87 experts, Sep 11) has Lamb around WR5 with an A+ start grade vs NYG. No new injury designation found on the Cowboys final report besides Davis.
player_signals.mongo_impact: Lamb is a locked Mongo FLEX/WR starter for Sunday night.
sources: FantasyPros Week 1 WR rankings / start-sit grades Sep 11 2026
Cowboys final Week 1 injury report context via Archer

player_signals.summary: FantasyPros Week 1 start/sit grades list Hurts A- vs Washington. No material new injury signal located in official/beat/X scan.
FantasyPros Week 1 PPR flex projections place Achane among the top RBs (~18.2 PPR). Dolphins have no Week 1 injury designations on the CBS tracker.
player_signals.mongo_impact: Locked Mongo RB start vs Las Vegas.

waiver_signals.summary: No Mongo waiver-watch rows exist in the repository. Expert chatter on Black as a waiver add is irrelevant because Black is already OWNED. Demercado is already OWNED. Pulse will not mark any player FREE_AGENT_CONFIRMED.

lineup_signals.summary: No Pulse-driven lineup change. Keep current Mongo Week 1 starters. Bench Black, Demercado, Miller, Tucker, Ray Davis, Sampson, Lane. Davis stays in IR.

expert_signals.topic: Week 1 start/sit consensus for JDD core
expert_signals.summary: FantasyPros Sep 11 consensus supports starting Hurts, Achane, Bijan, Lamb, and McMillan. Downs is a lower-grade WR flex (C) already locked into the Mongo FLEX. Dissent is limited to whether Tucker should be streamed over Downs; Pulse does not recommend that swap without new injury news.
expert_signals.mongo_impact: Current starter set is aligned with consensus. Monitor only Miller/Tucker for late Sunday role news.
sources: FantasyPros Week 1 rankings and grades, consensus updated Sep 11 2026
